Account Executive – Mid-Market (DACH)
Quotient Software · Dublin or Remote (Ireland/Germany)

The Role
Own the full sales cycle for mid-market customers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

What you'll do
- Generate and qualify pipeline through outbound prospecting
- Run discovery calls and product demos
- Negotiate and close new business

What you'll bring
- 3+ years of closing experience in B2B sales, ideally SaaS
- Track record of hitting quota
- Hands-on experience with Salesforce
- Strong negotiation skills
- Fluent English; native-level German is preferred
- Experience with MEDDIC or HubSpot is a nice bonus

Benefits
- OTE €120k (50/50 split), uncapped commission, equity
- 25 days holiday, remote-friendly, latest MacBook laptop

Quotient is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity.
